tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Divergence-free rows of the cofactor matrix] 1. ch8:8.1-lem-1\group Null Lagrangians Let $\mathbf{u} : \R ^n \to \R ^n$ be a smooth function. Then \[ \sum _{i=1}^n (\cof D\mathbf{u})^k_{i,x_i} = 0 \quad (k = 1, \ldots , n). \tag {20} \]

Proof

\sketch Differentiate the cofactor formula. Terms containing mixed second derivatives cancel in pairs by symmetry of derivatives and antisymmetry of the determinant expansion.

□
